.. change::
    :tags: bug, typing
    :tickets: 1883

    Fixed the type annotation for the
    :paramref:`.EnvironmentContext.configure.on_version_apply` callback,
    which was declared as a positional ``Callable`` even though the
    callback is invoked with keyword arguments only, as documented.
    The annotation is now a :class:`typing.Protocol` with keyword-only
    parameters ``ctx``, ``step``, ``heads`` and ``run_args``, so
    type checkers accept callbacks that match the actual invocation
    and reject callbacks whose parameter names would fail at runtime.
